loss: mean MSE on train-standardized three targets
selection: equal-horizon mean of validation plant-macro MAE divided by train target std
geometry_augmentation: none; point subsampling only; fixed initial DAS37 XYZ-median x/y translation shared by all dates, original z; no per-frame scaling
input_information: XYZ only, no normals or semantic/instance labels; real history DAS and requested target DAS
continue_rule: At least 10% mean improvement over both single-frame and repeated-latest on primary task, improvements in all 3 seeds, paired official plant-bootstrap upper95 < 0 for both; same >=10% pooled OOF improvements and >=3/4 folds directionally improve both. Otherwise REVIEW when engineering succeeds.
